system_description.narrative_title: Middle East-Iran War Driving Global Energy Shock and Market Volatility
system_description.narrative_summary: A regional conflict centered on Iran and proxy actors (notably Houthi attacks and Saudi responses) is the dominant force shaping headlines, producing acute disruptions to oil and gas flows, spikes in prices, and intense market volatility. Diplomatic mediation efforts and US political/military signaling interact with attacks, sanctions, and supply-side reactions (storage, rerouting, force majeure) to create dynamic feedbacks that transmit shock to consumers, airlines, and commodity markets worldwide.
system_description.scope: Inside the system boundary: military actions and proxy attacks tied to the Iran war; regional diplomatic mediation and peace-track initiatives; energy supply nodes (refineries, pipelines, shipping lanes, LNG cargoes), traders and market prices for oil and natural gas, national policy responses (sanctions, storage, force majeure), and downstream economic impacts (fuel prices, consumer costs, airline fares). Also included are information flows (intelligence, media, political rhetoric) that shape risk perception.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economic system (international security architecture coupled with global energy markets and commodity finance)
adjacent_subsystems: Global energy supply chains and infrastructure (shipping, storage, LNG terminals)
Regional security architectures in the Middle East and Red Sea/Strait of Hormuz transit corridor
International diplomatic and mediation mechanisms (Qatar, regional coalitions, UN)
Global commodity and financial markets (oil/gas trading, hedging, stocks)

variables.name: Conflict intensity
variables.description: The rate and severity of military actions and proxy attacks within the regional war theatre.

variables.name: Diplomatic activity
variables.description: The level and tempo of mediation, negotiation and high-level diplomatic engagement aimed at de-escalation.

variables.name: Information flow intensity
variables.description: The volume and salience of intelligence, media reporting and political messaging that circulate about the conflict and energy risks.

variables.name: Market risk perception
variables.description: The aggregate degree to which market participants perceive geopolitical and supply risks and price them into assets.

variables.name: Hydrocarbon supply flow
variables.description: The volumetric flow rate of oil and natural gas moving from production through midstream logistics to markets.

variables.name: Refinery output capacity
variables.description: The effective operational throughput capacity of refining infrastructure available to process crude into products.

variables.name: Strategic oil storage
variables.description: The aggregate stock of stored petroleum held in strategic and commercial reserves available to buffer supply shocks.

variables.name: Shipping lane disruption
variables.description: The degree of interference, delay or rerouting in maritime transit corridors critical to energy shipments.

variables.name: Force majeure incidence
variables.description: The frequency and probability that formal supply interruptions (force majeure declarations) are issued by sellers or operators.

variables.name: Sanctions pressure
variables.description: The intensity and breadth of economic and trade restrictions that impede energy production, trade or finance.

variables.name: Trading positioning
variables.description: The aggregate speculative and hedging positions and liquidity provision by market participants in oil and gas markets.

variables.name: Energy price volatility
variables.description: The short- and medium-term variability of oil and natural gas prices measured across relevant contracts and benchmarks.

variables.name: Consumer energy prices
variables.description: The average prices paid by households and end consumers for fuels, heating and transport energy services.

variables.name: Airline fuel hedge level
variables.description: The proportion of anticipated airline fuel consumption covered by hedging contracts or forward purchases.

variables.name: LNG rerouting rate
variables.description: The rate at which liquefied natural gas cargoes are redirected from their originally scheduled destinations.

variables.name: Commodity finance stress
variables.description: The level of strain and tightening in financial markets and credit channels that support commodity production, trading and shipping.

catalysts.title: U.S. leadership decision on confronting Iran
catalysts.description: A near-term U.S. policy decision to pursue a diplomatic deal or military escalation with Iran, which could materially shift regional posture and markets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Trump says he'll soon decide...' and 'U.S. Warns Gulf of Possible Short, Intense Renewal of Iran War...'.

catalysts.title: Qatar / U.S. mediation push to revive talks
catalysts.description: Intensive mediation efforts (Qatar, U.S. envoys) aimed at restarting ceasefire/peace talks with Iran and regional parties.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Qatari mediators present Iran with new deal', 'Vance reaches out to Iranian hard-liner', 'Vance engaged Iran to revive peace talks'.

catalysts.title: Continued Houthi attacks on energy and transport
catalysts.description: Ongoing Houthi strikes targeting Saudi oil facilities, pumping stations and airports, with risk of further supply disruption.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Houthis say they hit Saudi Ras Tanura refinery', 'Houthis say they attacked pumping stations, Riyadh airport', 'Houthis strike Aden airport'.

catalysts.title: Qatar extends LNG force majeure to end-December
catalysts.description: Extension of force majeure on Qatari LNG cargoes (to Italy's Edison) through end-December, affecting deliveries and routing.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Qatar extends force majeure on LNG cargoes to Italy's Edison until end-December'.

catalysts.title: Saudi to store oil in Singapore caverns
catalysts.description: Planned storage of Saudi crude in Singapore caverns to bolster Asian supply security and create a regional buffer.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Saudi Arabia to store oil in Singapore to bolster Asia supply security' and 'Singapore to store Saudi Arabian oil in caverns'.

catalysts.title: Continued weekly U.S. crude inventory draws
catalysts.description: Ongoing EIA weekly draws in U.S. crude stocks that reduce available commercial/strategic stocks and influence markets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'U.S. Crude Oil Stockpiles Fall for Fourth Straight Week' and 'US crude and distillate inventories fall'.

catalysts.title: European winter gas demand and supply squeeze
catalysts.description: Rising winter demand and supply fears push European gas prices sharply higher, stressing markets and prompting rerouting.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'European Gas at Four-Year High', 'European Gas Prices Top 100 Euros on Middle East Escalation Fears'.

catalysts.title: Airlines pull back on fuel hedges
catalysts.description: Airlines scale back fuel hedging coverage, increasing exposure to spot-price swings and pass-through to fares.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'As Iran war drags on, airlines pull back on fuel hedges and warn on fares'.

catalysts.title: Elevated U.S. refinery stocks as short-term buffer
catalysts.description: High refinery stocks in the U.S. that can temporarily mitigate product shortages but may be drawn down fast.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'U.S. oil-refinery stocks are up roughly 150% this year. How long could this historic run last?'

catalysts.title: Hezbollah mobilisation and funding increase
catalysts.description: Reported Hezbollah readiness and funding increases raise the risk of wider regional escalation and proxy attacks.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Hezbollah readies for new regional war with funds from Iran, sources say.'
